content.errorCountConvention: Each listed scenario has one planted error except SC-TASK-FIELDS, which has two. Independent cases, not seven errors in each packet.
content.timingProvenance: Invented assumptions; no SME baseline or measured fleet benefit.

scenarios.name: SC-FORMS Complete both tracks
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Extract the documented source fields; flag training duration 6O until a reviewer chooses 60. Completed forms equal the three form records. Four deduplicated actions equal ANSWER-TASKS; only two verified actions enter its exact statusDraft. Require explicit review for each exact revision, queue routes offline, then simulate local routing on reconnect. Cite source regions/lines and schedule rule IDs.

scenarios.name: SC-QUANTITY Missing requisition quantity
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Quantity is required. Preserve draft; block approval and routing. Correct to 12; clear this error and retain all other fields.

scenarios.name: SC-HAND Uncertain duration glyph
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Duration is ambiguous. Do not auto-approve 60. Show R4 and alternatives; reviewer selects 60 minutes and records correction against the new revision.

scenarios.name: SC-DATE Impossible date
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Enter a valid calendar date. Preserve draft; block routing. Correct to 2026-10-26.

scenarios.name: SC-UNIT Unsupported unit
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Unit must be EA or BOX. Correct to EA; do not silently normalize.

scenarios.name: SC-ENC Missing enclosure
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Enclosure ART-ENC is missing. Block completion/routing; adding ART-ENC resolves the error.

scenarios.name: SC-TASK-FIELDS Missing task owner and due date
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Task owner is required. Task due date is required. TASK-UNKNOWN stays needs-review and is excluded from verified status drafts.

scenarios.name: SC-TASK-AMEND Amendment and duplicate forward
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Exactly one TASK-SUPPLY remains; due 2026-10-30T16:00:00-04:00, completed. Preserve all four source citations; a forward creates no extra action.

scenarios.name: SC-TASK-CONFLICT Unmarked contradictory tasking
scenarios.expectedBehavior: TASK-TRAIN has two owner candidates and two due candidates as ANSWER-TASKS; preserve both and require human selection. Latest timestamp alone does not settle this conflict.

scenarios.name: SC-UNKNOWN-CATEGORY No matching records rule
scenarios.expectedBehavior: No matching synthetic schedule rule. Hold for records reviewer; no retention date or automatic disposal.

scenarios.name: SC-REPLAY Duplicate and reversed operation delivery
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Before merge the exact head set is [OP-A, OP-B, OP-DEL], lexically sorted. Replay has no duplicate effect; reversed delivery yields identical canonical operations and head set. Preserve missing-parent children until parents arrive.

scenarios.name: SC-MERGE Explicit conflict resolution
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Only OP-MERGE is a head; quantity 14 and deleted false. Preserve edit and tombstone history; require explicit reviewer choice. Approval binds OP-MERGE only; route transitions match AUDIT-01 after corresponding human actions.

scenarios.name: SC-APPROVAL Unreviewed or stale submission
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Approval is required for this revision. Block routing for an unreviewed revision and after any edit, including a content-equivalent new revision; preserve the old decision in audit history.

scenarios.name: SC-RESTART Offline reload
scenarios.expectedBehavior: After acknowledged durable save, reload retains OP-A, draft content, source references, audit and pending outbox; no route or external request occurs. Reconnect alone does not approve anything.

scenarios.name: SC-STORAGE Write failure
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Save failed: storage unavailable. Do not report Saved or add a successful-save audit event; retain editable draft quantity 15 and prior durable revision. Retry after capacity recovery, then acknowledge one committed save.

scenarios.name: SC-TRANSFER Bounded priority resume
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Send ART-REQ first: 174 bytes, then 850 bytes of ART-PHOTO starting at offset 2048. After acknowledgments offsets are 174 and 2898; total new bytes 1024. Next budget 4096 sends remaining 1198 photo bytes only; final offset 4096. No retransmission of acknowledged bytes.

scenarios.name: SC-INTERRUPT Lost acknowledgment and stop sync
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Acknowledged offset remains 2048; preserve outbox and halt further attempts. Retry resumes at 2048; receiver deduplicates already received chunks. Advance offset to 2560 only after acknowledgment; never infer success from attempted bytes.

scenarios.name: SC-BUDGET Invalid offset and zero budget
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Reject acknowledgedOffset beyond size 4096 without mutation. With corrected offset 2048 and budget 0, plan zero bytes and leave offset unchanged.

scenarios.name: SC-HOSTILE Embedded source instruction
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Treat hostile text as quoted source data; execute nothing, retrieve no secrets and contact no endpoint. It adds no task and grants no approval.

scenarios.name: SC-TIMING Synthetic estimate
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Estimated savings: (24 - 9) × 8 / 60 = 2 hours; 7/7 planted errors expected caught across six independent error cases. Label assumptions and estimates synthetic; actual observed time, Fleet SME baseline and operational error reduction remain unmeasured.

scenarios.name: SC-EMPTY No packets yet
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Show empty local workspace with synthetic import option; zero tasks, conflicts, routes and transferred bytes. No automatic approval or invented records.

scenarios.name: SC-RESET Destructive reset cancelled
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Offer export and require confirmation. Cancellation preserves all saved revisions, decisions, source assets and queued transfers.

scenarios.name: SC-REVIEW-SHEET Unscored human assessment
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Review worksheet states Awaiting human assessment; all scores remain unassigned. No panel endorsement, owner approval, pilot execution or operational deployment is inferred.

limitations: Fictional inputs, grammar, data and rules; no real-format validation. No operational records, personal information, external retrieval or real synchronization endpoint.

The handwritten-style SVG is renderable simulated handwriting, not a raster scan or pen sample. No OCR engine or recognition implementation is provided here; downstream extraction must inspect source regions, expose uncertainty and permit corrections rather than use answer-key lookup.
DD 1348-1A-style and correspondence layouts are invented demonstrations, not official blanks or official field/routing validation. Requisition date is a declared capture-context assumption.
Records rules SYN-R1 through SYN-R4 are invented calendar-day holds for human disposal review; never real retention authority or automatic deletion.
Source sender and recipient labels are fictional role tokens; no actual identities, addresses, stock identifiers or credentials. Transfer photo is ASCII placeholder bytes, not a photograph.
Synthetic task verification and reviewer decisions describe expected demonstrations, not automatic approval or permission to submit.

Manual timing, workload and error counts are assumptions. No measured SME baseline, actual Sailor hours saved, panel judgment, official scores, government device certification or platform deployment is supplied.

Durable browser storage, real OCR, authenticated transport, device encryption and deployment are not created or verified by these data. Host must validate and freeze artifacts; owner approval remains required before eventual delivery/deployment.
